description: Road and railway networks and market density is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. The Commune Database is produced by the NCDD (National Committee for Subnational Democratic Development). This file contains excerpts of the Database, namely the road and railway networks in relation to market density data. Data were provided to ODC in vector and raster format by Save Cambodia's Wildlife's Atlas Working Group. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Infrastructure, Markets, Rail, Roads and bridges. It offers 6 resource(s) in db_table, geojson, jpeg, kml, shp. The portal shows 2019-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
